$comment: The short loops that play in a link's preview, where the app plays them (iMessage, Discord). Cut by `npm run og:videos` (scripts/generate-og-videos.mjs) into public/og/video/<name>.mp4; read by src/lib/linkPreview.ts. Each clip is a stretch of a video in public/: `cover` fills the frame, `contain` sits the whole picture at full height on `backdrop` (a picture, or a colour for footage with a flat ground of its own). `invite` and the home link's scenes are recorded from the site itself instead (see the script).
